customManagers.description: The read-only Drydock core the Objective-C artifact reader compiles (components/objc-reader-drydock/version). scripts/objc-compat-build.sh fetches GitHub's tarball of exactly DIGEST through fetch_pinned_source.sh and verifies it against ARCHIVE_SHA256, which this manager does not move: a bump fails closed until ARCHIVE_SHA256 is rewritten after checking with git that the tarball holds exactly the commit's tree. A bump must pass tests/objc-reader-test.sh and tests/objc-binding-test.sh.

The Xcode-project source exporter MavergreenHostTools.cmake builds for the host (components/mulle-xcode-to-cmake/version): REF is the upstream branch tracked, DIGEST its pinned commit, TARBALL_SHA256 the digest of GitHub's tarball of that commit, which fetch_pinned_source.sh verifies.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves .mavergreen/ingredients/clang22/VERSION but cannot write the Linux archive's digest beside it, so the Linux job fails on the bump until .mavergreen/ingredients/clang22/LINUX_SHA256 holds the new release's archive digest.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, write the digest of `clang22-<version>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` from the new release's SHA256SUMS, alone, to .mavergreen/ingredients/clang22/LINUX_SHA256: `gh release download <version> -R Mavergreen/clang-22 -p SHA256SUMS -O - | awk '$2 ~ /linux-x86_64[.]tar[.]gz$/ { print $1 }' > .mavergreen/ingredients/clang22/LINUX_SHA256`.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves DIGEST in components/mulle-xcode-to-cmake/version but cannot write TARBALL_SHA256 beside it, so the host-tool build refuses the bump until that digest names GitHub's tarball of the new commit, checked against the commit's tree.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, set TARBALL_SHA256 in components/mulle-xcode-to-cmake/version to the SHA-256 of `https://codeload.github.com/mulle-nat/mulle-xcode-to-cmake/tar.gz/<new DIGEST>`, after checking that the tarball's files are that commit's tree (`git archive` of the commit compared with the extracted tarball).

packageRules.description: The renovate pin moves at most monthly: each bump costs macOS runner time in shipyard's CI and then its release, and the validator gains nothing from tracking Renovate's every release.
schedule: on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: linux-host.yml's setup-node runs Renovate's own config validator, whose package requires node ^24.11.0, so node stays on 24 until a renovate pin needs another major.
